title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.16078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in self-improving LLM agents have demonstrated the potential of AI systems that drive their own intelligence. However, many domain-specific applications rely on specialized foundation models that possess strong domain expertise but remain dependent on human-designed improvements. Extending recursive self-improvement to these models presents a key challenge: as a specialist improves, the strategies used to advance it must also adapt. To address this challenge, we propose Heterogeneous Agentic CoEvolution (HACE), a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning. HACE improves the specialist through supervised learning while training the agent with on-policy reinforced self-training, guided by verified performance gains on the current specialist. translated_abstract: 自我改进的LLM智能体的最新进展展示了AI系统驱动自身智能的潜力。然而，许多领域特定的应用依赖于专业化的基础模型，这些模型拥有强大的领域专业知识，但仍依赖人类设计的改进。将递归自我改进扩展到这些模型面临一个关键挑战：随着专业化模型的改进，用于推进它的策略也必须随之调整。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了异构智能体协同进化（HACE），这是一个通过相互学习共同进化专业化基础模型和LLM智能体的框架。HACE通过监督学习改进专业化模型，同时采用在策略强化自训练来训练智能体，并以在当前专业化模型上经过验证的性能提升为指导。智能体的探索反过来又为后续的专业化模型训练提供信息，使两个模型能够相互适应彼此的进展。
tldr: 提出HACE框架，通过相互学习让专业化基础模型与LLM智能体共同进化，解决了专业化模型递归自我改进中改进策略需同步适应的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposes HACE, a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning, addressing the key challenge of recursive self-improvement for specialist models.
